modelNotes: Rebounds Board 1.0 uses season rebounds, last 5 rebounds, last 10 rebounds, expected minutes, minutes confidence, position role, and recent rebound trend.
Rebounds Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent rebound rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Avdija (foot) is listed as questionable ahead of Thursday's game against Milwaukee.
injury.detail: Avdija missed his first game of the 2026-27 campaign Tuesday. If he stays on the shelf for a second consecutive contest, Jayson Kent is in line to remain in the starting lineup

injury.shortComment: Kuminga (shoulder) is questionable for Thursday's game against the Knicks, Charlie Walton of ZoneCoverage.com reports.
injury.detail: After missing Tuesday's game against Portland, Kuminga now has a chance to return Thursday from a bruised shoulder. His status will affect Terrence Shannon's streaming appeal most prominently in fantasy leagues.

injury.shortComment: Camara is questionable to play Thursday against the Bucks due to general soreness.
injury.detail: Camara is in danger of missing his first game of the season due to general soreness. If he's forced to the sidelines, his minutes will be divvied up amongst Siddy Cissoko and Jrue Holiday.

injury.shortComment: Stewart is questionable for Thursday's game against the Warriors due to an illness.
injury.detail: Memphis is likely to check back in with Stewart closer to tipoff. The big man has a golden opportunity Thursday to start if available, with Zach Edey (ankle) already ruled out for the second half of this back-to-bac.

injury.shortComment: Cryer (back) is questionable for Thursday's game against Memphis.
injury.detail: Cryer is at risk of missing the second half of this back-to-back set. De'Anthony Melton could be moved into a larger role if Cryer is sidelined.
